newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Hang Seng Index breaks above 15,000 points.
newsitem.headline: HK's Hang Seng Index breaks above 15,000 points.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks reversed course in Tuesday morning trade, with the blue chip Hang Seng Index breaking above the 15,000 point mark for the first time.
The Hang Seng Index was up 24 points, or 0.16 percent, at 15,014 after dropping 148 points in early trade.
"I see 15,500 easily attainable by Friday," said James Osborn, sales director at ING Barings.

"Hong Kong could break up very, very sharply and because of the magnitude of the expected spike, there definitely seems to be an attitude that this is definitely one rise they don't want to miss," he said. -- Hong Kong newsroom (852) 2843 6369
